name: Orders in the violet city

date.label: Wrath of the Lich King, patch 3.3.5 quest sequence; exact in-world date unknown

summary: In Dalaran, Caladis Brightspear and Myralion Sunblaze each direct their own faction’s search. Their orders are parallel branches in the quest, not a single council where both factions agree. The city’s pale towers and violet enchantments stand above a contest of memory: each side would restore the old blade, and each expects its own people to guard the inheritance.
